top_signals.title: Stocks Fall as Huang Resigns, Nvidia Turns to CFO
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg Television brings you the latest news and analysis leading up to the final minutes and seconds before and after the closing bell on Wall Street. Today's guests are Ross Gerber, Gerber Kawasaki Wealth and Investment Management Co-Founder, President & CEO, Emily Kilcrease, Center for a New American Security Senior Fellow & Director,  Nell Minow, ValueEdge Advisors Chair, Carolyn Everson, Permira Senior advisor, Dan Clancy, Twitch CEO, Jim Caron, Morgan Stanley Investment Management CIO, Portfolio Solutions, Julie Biel, Kayne Anderson Rudnick Portfolio Manager, Mehdi Hosseini, Susquehanna International Senior Equity Research Analyst, Charles Elson, University of Delaware Weinberg Center for Corporate Governance Founding Director, Cam Harvey, Duke University Professor of Finance, Chris McGuire, Council on Foreign Relations Senior Fellow for China and Emerging Technologies. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Rare Earth Wars: U.S. General Sounds Alarm Over China's Military Leverage
top_signals.summary: On November 3, retired four-star General Jack Keane, the Army's former Vice Chief of Staff, put a warning on the record: China "has made clear it is prepared to use [America’s] dependence as leverage." The dependence he's talking about is America's reliance on Chinese rare earths. And he didn't say it from a cable news set. He said it as a director of REalloys [NASDAQ: ALOY], the company the Army recently selected for exclusive negotiations to build a plant to process dysprosium and terbium on one of its own military bases.
